targetReport.title: Handbook on Residential Property Prices Indices (RPPIs)
targetReport.publisher: Eurostat, ILO, IMF, OECD, UNECE and the World Bank
targetReport.description: The international methodological handbook for residential property (house) price indices, 2013 edition, published by Eurostat (catalogue KS-RA-12-022) and copyrighted jointly by the European Union, the International Labour Organization, the International Monetary Fund, the OECD, the UN Economic Commission for Europe and the World Bank. It covers the uses of RPPIs, stratification, hedonic regression, repeat-sales and appraisal-based methods, the land/structures split, data sources and recommendations. The publisher's own title spells it 'Prices Indices'; citing documents usually write 'Price Indices'. Minted 2026-10-17 as the hub of the housing research lane.
targetReport.cadence_note: One edition so far (2013); 0.05 is a once-a-generation revision rate written as a number.

The Finnish version says the same ('Uusien omakotitalojen tiedot perustuvat rakennuskustannusindeksiin'), but the grader cannot match the inflected Finnish form (graded B quote-found-target-not-named on the Finnish page), so the English page of the same documentation is cited. targetReport.title: Building cost index
targetReport.description: Statistics Finland's monthly index of building costs in professional new building, from the price development of basic inputs (materials, labour, services), collected by inquiry and from Statistics Finland's other data. Statistics Finland's Real estate prices statistics base their new single-family house prices on it. Minted 2026-10-18.

The data are supplied by Rakennustutkimus RTS Oy. In addition, the price index uses the building cost index of residential detached houses and the volume index of newbuilding for detached houses. Frequency of data collection (SIMS 18.2)
 The transaction prices in the National Land Survey's purchase price register are submitted to Statistics Finland monthly.
